subject: English
passage: The excavation of a 2,000-year-old Roman villa in southern France has uncovered numerous glass vessels and decorative objects. Using infrared spectroscopy, archaeologist Dr. Hoa Bui and her research team were able to analyze the molecular structure of these glass artifacts without causing any damage. By comparing the spectroscopic signatures of the glass pieces with those of materials collected from ancient Roman glassmaking workshops across the Mediterranean, Bui and her team can determine which specific workshops likely created the glass objects.
prompt: Which choice best states the main idea of the text?

choices.A: Because of advanced technology, researchers can locate and excavate more Roman sites than they could in the past.
choices.B: Researchers have been able to identify the location of a number of Roman glassmaking workshops in operation 2,000 years ago.
choices.C: With the help of a specialized technique, researchers have determined the likely origin of glass artifacts recovered from an excavation.
choices.D: Before the development of infrared spectroscopy, researchers needed to break off a small piece of an artifact to analyze its molecular structure.

explanation:
Choice C is the best answer because it most accurately states the main idea of the text. According to the text, numerous glass vessels and objects were found in an excavated Roman villa. The text goes on to say that Bui and her team used a specialized technique, infrared spectroscopy, to determine the glass artifacts' molecular signatures. Comparing these signatures with those of materials they had collected from ancient Roman workshops, the text says, allowed the researchers to identify which workshops had created the glass pieces. In other words, the researchers determined the artifacts' origin.

Why D is incorrect:

Choice D is incorrect. Although the text says that using infrared spectroscopy enabled Bui and her team to analyze artifacts in the form of glass objects without causing damage, the text doesn't discuss how researchers analyzed artifacts before this technique was developed. Moreover, the point that the glass pieces were left undamaged isn't the text's main idea. Rather, it's a detail that's provided to develop the main idea, which is that the researchers used a specialized technique to determine where the glass objects had been produced.
